title: Merchandise Purchases — Second Capture of the Same Tender on One Unit
content:
**Rule.** A Merchandise Purchases unit whose payment records show the tender of its latest payment capture captured more than once for the unit carries a second capture: the customer paid twice with that tender for one unit, whereas the one capture per tender recorded for a mixed-tender unit is a single payment.

**Scope.** For a second capture of a unit's payment that this policy handles, and only for such a capture, the register-error adjustment is still made at any time while the unit is not returned and still counts toward no limit, and it refunds the second capture together with the held-capture credit and goodwill amounts; every other register error, including a unit rung above its shelf ticket; registry credit recorded as spent but left undeducted; the card money taken for a Finch Note recorded as redeemed but left undeducted; sales tax charged on the part a Finch Note paid; and gift card or Bonus Card value recorded as redeemed but left undeducted, stays under the base rule or the rule written for it.

**Destination.** The refund goes to the unit's original tender and the correction records no new unit price.

## Telling a second capture from a mixed-tender payment (hypothetical records)

| Payment captures recorded for the unit | Tender of the latest capture captured more than once? | Second capture? |
|---|---|---|
| debit $64.80, then debit $64.80 | Yes — debit twice | Yes |
| gift card $20.00, then debit $44.80 (mixed tender) | No — debit once | No |
| bank card $64.80 only | No | No |

## Booking the refund — `refund_duplicate_capture_6e7f744e`

**Capability.** Books a duplicate-capture refund on one purchase record: a register-error price adjustment that returns a second capture of the unit's payment, together with any credits owed for it. On success one price adjustment entry with the current date and the reason register price error is added to the unit's records, with no new unit price; the amount goes back to the tender the unit was paid with, and the unit's amount paid and not refunded goes down by the same amount. The payment entries themselves are left as recorded. The customer sees the refund on the original tender.

**How it is invoked.** `refund_duplicate_capture_6e7f744e` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
- `purchase_id` — the reference number of the purchase record (one unit of one item) whose payment was captured twice, as returned by the purchase lookup for this customer; identifier text.
- `amount` — the total refunded by this entry; USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; never empty.

Neither parameter takes an enumerated value.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new price adjustment reference number (an opaque text reference), the purchase record reference number, the amount refunded (USD, 2 decimal places), the tender refunded, and the unit's remaining amount paid and not refunded (USD, 2 decimal places). A sentence starting with "Duplicate-capture refund booked" means the entry was recorded.
